result.sentence: 1,000 MWh in ERCT is about 332.87 metric tons of CO₂. With other gases, it is 334.14 tons of CO₂e (eGRID2023).

work.method: Multiply the energy by the subregion's eGRID2023 total output emission rate for each gas (lb/MWh), convert pounds to metric tons (0.45359237 kg/lb), and add CH₄ and N₂O to CO₂ with the 100-year global warming potentials eGRID uses (AR5: 28 and 265).
steps: eGRID2023 total output emission rates for ERCT: 733.862 lb/MWh CO₂, 0.043 lb/MWh CH₄, 0.006 lb/MWh N₂O.
CO₂e: CO₂ + 28 × CH₄ + 265 × N₂O = 334.14 metric tons (AR5 100-year GWPs, as eGRID uses).
These are annual average rates for every hour of the year. With interval data, hourly rates give a better answer, because the grid's mix changes hour by hour.

constants.source: EPA eGRID2023, subregion total output emission rate

assumptions: The subregion's average rate over the whole year applies to every MWh, whenever it was used (location-based accounting).
Total output rates include all generation in the subregion; they are not marginal or hourly rates.

citations.source: EPA, Emissions & Generation Resource Integrated Database (eGRID2023)
citations.locator: Subregion file: total output emission rates (lb/MWh) for CO₂, CH₄, N₂O, and CO₂e
CO₂ equivalent emissions, PDF page 23: GWPs from AR5 without climate-carbon feedbacks (CH₄ 28, N₂O 265)
